questions.prompt: A discrete random variable \(X\) takes values \( 0,1,2 \) with probabilities \( 0.2,0.5,0.3 \). Check the probabilities and find \(E(X)\).
questions.answer: The probabilities sum to \( 1 \), so this is a valid distribution. The expectation is \[E(X)=0(0.2)+1(0.5)+2(0.3)=1.1.\]
